eps.t: Get the Show on the Road!
eps.ov: Pikachu is suffering from a serious electrical overload! Can Ash and Professor Birch find a solution before it's too late?
eps.oa: «بيكاتشو» يعاني حملاً كهربائياً زائداً خطيراً! أيجد «ساتوشي» والبروفيسور «أوداماكي» حلاً قبل فوات الأوان؟

eps.ov: A power failure at the Pokémon Center leads Ash and his new friend May to an astonishing discovery!
eps.oa: انقطاع الكهرباء في مركز البوكيمون يقود «ساتوشي» وصديقته الجديدة «هاروكا» إلى اكتشاف مذهل!

eps.ov: Ash is ready for his first Gym battle in the Hoenn region--and the Gym Leader he must face is none other than May's father!
When Team Rocket turns a flock of Taillow against our heroes, an old friend comes to the rescue!
Ash and friends meet an eccentric Trainer who challenges May to her very first Pokémon battle!
Our heroes are on the trail of a Pokémon poacher, and Team Rocket is close behind!
When Ash gets lost in the woods, he meets a Treecko who's determined to save its forest home.
Ash's Treecko takes on a wild Seviper, but things don't go so well...
Stopping in Rinshin Town, our heroes investigate the mystery of a haunted mansion!
Ash can't resist challenging a Trainer who claims to have the world's most powerful Pokémon, but there's something odd about this battle...
After meeting a group of Mightyena, Max befriends a Poochyena who hasn't evolved yet and decides to train it himself!
Our heroes meet three sisters who grow berries with the help of a nearby group of Lotad!
Ash and friends discover a whole new kind of Pokémon competition, and it seems May has found her calling!
As May sets out to catch a Wurmple for her first Pokémon Contest, Ash receives a Double Battle challenge!
Our heroes check out the Pokémon Trainer's School in Rustboro City, where Max has a run-in with a classmate!
Armed with Pikachu's new Iron Tail attack, Ash challenges Gym Leader Roxanne!
As our heroes tour the massive Devon Corporation, a mysterious intruder tries to steal an important piece of equipment!

eps.t: On a Wingull and a Prayer!
eps.ov: Mr. Briney the sailor offers to take our heroes to Dewford Island for Ash's next Gym battle, but then changes his mind. What's going on?
When a school of Sharpedo attacks, Ash and friends are stranded on an uncharted island!

Ash challenges the Dewford Gym, but Gym Leader Brawly seems more interested in surfing!ets the Gym Leader Brawly, who would rather surf than battle, which infuriates Ash. Could there be more to this Gym Leader than meets the eye? And does May even have a shred of decency?
May and Jessie of Team Rocket both have a Wurmple, and the two Pokémon accidentally get swapped during a battle!
Ash and friends meet Steven Stone in Granite Cave, where they quickly fall into one of Team Rocket's traps!
A mysterious Pokémon keeps burrowing through the beach near our heroes' camp and knocking over everything in its way!
When Ash's rowdy new Corphish eats something it shouldn't, he goes on a dangerous journey to get it to the Pokémon Center!
Ash and friends come across a lake full of Mudkip and soon find themselves protecting the Pokémon from a Team Rocket scheme!
When our heroes get separated from their Pokémon in a deep, dark cave, both groups find themselves in trouble!
Ash and the others meet up with Professor Birch for a day of exploration and end up in the middle of a villainous confrontation!
Jessie of Team Rocket is sure her Pokémon will evolve into a lovely Beautifly someday, but she could be in for a rude awakening!
Deciding it's time to teach his unruly Corphish a lesson, Ash leads the Pokémon into an abandoned mine, where things are not as they seem...
The approach of a dangerous storm calls a halt to Ash's latest battle challenge!
In a secret island arena with an unusual battlefield, Dewford Gym Leader Brawly welcomes Ash for a rematch!
Our heroes find themselves aboard an abandoned ship...and then start disappearing one by one!
While May trains for the Pokémon Contest in Slateport City, Torchic's appetite for berries gets her in trouble!

eps.t: Having a Wailord of a Time
eps.ov: A new Trainer is stopping by a Pokémon Center to choose her first partner Pokémon, and Nurse Joy asks Ash and Max to take care of Treecko, Torchic, and Mudkip for her!
It's time for May's first Pokémon Contest! Does her Beautifly have what it takes to win a ribbon?
A day of relaxation in Slateport City turns into a confrontation between Team Rocket and Team Magma!
Ash and friends stop at a Pokémon Center for directions, but there's no sign of Nurse Joy! What could have happened to her?
Ash and friends visit a lighthouse, where they try to return a stolen item they recovered from Team Rocket--but the lighthouse keepers think our heroes are the thieves!
Ash and friends join the Trick House Contest, which sends them through a maze full of tricks and traps--and, of course, Team Rocket!
When Ash challenges the Mauville City Gym, he soon finds himself face to face with the Legendary Pokémon Raikou, or so it would seem...

eps.t: What You Seed Is What You Get
eps.ov: When Ash's Treecko and Corphish face Grovyle and Slugma in a double battle, Treecko turns the tables, learning to use Bullet Seed.
Our heroes discover a love story between two Trainers who star with their Pokémon in a local dance festival.
A Trainer learns that Pokémon battling requires more than tactics and technology. Meanwhile, a Bagon dreams the impossible dream of taking flight.
An invitation to the Togepi Festival brings Misty to the Hoenn region, where she learns that a local kingdom bases its rule on the whims of passing Togepi.
Our heroes go up against an evil regent who would use Misty's Togepi to steal the throne from its rightful heir!
Ash, Brock, May, and Max must all work together to face the four members of a family of skilled Pokémon Trainers and their powerful Pokémon.
After her Skitty is exhausted by chasing its own tale, May entrusts it to a local aromatherapy house, where it recovers completely.
A young trainer gains confidence and strengthens his bond with his Zangoose, when he is forced to face Seviper in a less than fair battle.
Max meets another young boy who shares his name, but differs greatly in personality. When this young and inexperienced new acquaintance goes off on his own, Ash and friends must track him down.
As May prepares for her first contest, Ash faces another contestant in a pre-contest battle.
May wins her first contest, finally earning a ribbon. Jessie of Team Rocket attempts to win by cheating, but is disqualified.
Ash and friends meet an old friend who has since joined a Pokémon cheering squad. When they expose his squad for a fake, the trainer is inspired to start anew.
When Team Rocket threatens an innocent family of ranchers, Ash and friends drive them away, with May's Eneko using Assist for the first time.
When Team Aqua and Team Magma battle to gain a meteor on Mount chimney, Ash and friends must put an end to both of their dastardly plans.
No sooner has Ash begun an official battle with a novice gym leader, Flannery, than Team Rocket interrupts, postponing the battle for an extra day.
Ash is battling for his fourth Hoenn region Gym badge! Can his Corphish defeat Flannery's team of Fire types?
When rumors arise that a particular Spinda draws happiness to its trainer, Team Rocket quickly hatches a plan to steal this lucky Pokémon.
Ash and friends struggle to pass through a valley guarded by territorial Steel Pokémon.
While Ash uses his Torkoal to battle the powerful Watson, May faces his assistant with her Skitty.
When May's Skitty is injured far from a Pokémon Center, a master in the art of Pokémon massage comes to the rescue!
When Ash and friends learn that a masked coordinator is attempting to compete in secret, they help the timid boy hide his identity.
At Vendanturf Town, the masked trainer makes a strong performance, but loses to May's Skitty, as May wins her second ribbon.
The people of a small village blame a local drought on the Pokémon Solrock, but it soon comes to light that the drought is in fact the work of Team Rocket.
May feels a special duty to help a wounded Swablu return to its flock.
Mayhem ensues when Professor Oak inadvertently creates a gigantic Gulpin and Treecko in an effort to stop a Gulpin outbreak.
Even as Ash's Treecko evolves in the course of battle, his opponent's Loudred does the same. Team Rocket couldn't have picked a worse time to attack.
Ash and friends must rely on Grovyle, Torkoal, and Corphish, as they approach Petalburg City.
When May and Max's father, Norman, reaches near celebrity status, Team Rocket pretends to be a part of the family.
Rumors are spreading about Nurse Joy spending a little too much time with Norman, Max and May's father! What's going on?
Ash has challenged Max and May's father, Norman, to a battle before—but this time, it's for a Gym badge!
When Professor Oak makes a surprise appearance in Hoenn, bringing along Bulbasaur, Charmander, and Squirtle, Ash joins forces with them to battle Team Rocket.
When Ash and May face a duo in a double Pokémon battle, a falling out between these two friends causes them to lose--but they soon resolve their differences.
When May accidentally enters a forbidden spot where only grass Pokémon live, she quickly befriends a friendly Bulbasaur.
May lets her Bulbasaur out of its Pokéball and the curious Pokémon soon gets into trouble.
When a famed Whiscash swallows Ash's Gym badges, he teams up with a fisherman to try to reel it in!
Ash and Pikachu meet up with an aspiring archaeologist who leads them to an ancient and mystical site.
May prepares to enter her first contest open only to ribbon holders, but remains confident despite seeing the contest favorite and his powerful Masquerain.
May decides to use Bulbasaur in the Rubello Town Contest. Will its lack of experience cost her a ribbon?

eps.t: Pearls Are a Spoink's Best Friend
eps.ov: When a Spoink loses the pearl on its head, Ash and friends volunteer to help search for it.
Ash, May, and Brock participate in a curious sporting event in which players use rings dangling from balloons to catch balls lying on the ground.
Fights arise both between May and Max and amongst Team Rocket, as a Shuppet--a Pokémon that feeds on human anger--stirs them to conflict.
Team Rocket infuriates a Breloom, forcing not only themselves, but also Ash and friends to flee from its wrath.
Ash and friends learn of Groudon and Kyogre, when Team Magma is joined by a master of disguise.
Ash and friends meet up with the beautiful gym leader, Winona, at the Feather Carnival.
It's Swellow versus Swellow as Ash and Winona battle it out in the Fortree City Gym!

As the heroes continue onwards, they encounter a man pushing his Camerupt. After helping the man, the heroes are told the man, named Elijah, goes around villages and shows movies. The heroes decide to accompany them, while Team Rocket plans on stealing his equipment.
A group of conspiracy theorists known as the Pokémon Mystery Club pursues a Lunatone suspected to be behind a recent series of strange events.
A troubled Snorlax wanders into a public park, creating no end of trouble.
A fierce bout of amnesia causes Pikachu to join forces with Team Rocket!
Before taking part in the Lilycove Coordinator Contest, May has time to study the art of Pokéblock preparation with a local master
The Lilycove Coordinator Contest is underway but things are not looking good for May--her Combusken's Fire Spin has spiraled out of control!
Hoping to get to Mossdeep Island, Ash and the gang are forced to take a detour.
Our heroes reconnect with an unlucky Spoink, and it's still having trouble holding onto its pearl!
Ash and friends join a treasure hunter to explore the deep sea, but Team Rocket is right behind them!
When a Gorebyss-versus-Huntail rivalry develops between two islands, our heroes must get to the bottom of it!
The residents of Muscle Island are dedicated to physical fitness-but can they keep up with Ash in a Pokémon battle?
After a rescue at sea, our heroes find themselves aboard Team Magma's submarine and learn more about the group's plan for world domination!
Team Aqua and Team Magma have awakened the ancient Legendary Pokémon Groudon and Kyogre! Can Ash and friends escape?

eps.t: It's Still Rocket Roll to Me
eps.ov: A Team Rocket strike on Mossdeep City drags our heroes-plus the city's twin Gym Leaders-into a space-shuttle scheme!
Ash takes on the Mossdeep Gym, going up against two Gym Leaders at once!
After winning his seventh Gym badge, Ash can't stop bragging about his battle skills...until he runs into a member of the Elite Four!
In an island nature preserve, Ash and friends come face to face with several Pokémon thought to be extinct!
May competes in a Pokémon Contest, where another Coordinator tries to sabotage her performance!
When our heroes discover an enormous Poké Ball on an island, Team Rocket's meddling unleashes an ancient destructive force!
Ash and friends meet a talented Trainer who performs a ribbon dance with her Mawile...until Team Rocket gets in the way!
To help a local researcher, our heroes explore a massive underground labyrinth created by a group of Trapinch...and get into some trouble along the way!
An Absol appears to warn a village of danger, but the villagers think it's the one causing the trouble! Can our heroes clear up this misunderstanding?

eps.t: Let It Snow, Let It Snow, Let It Snorunt
eps.ov: When a mischievous Snorunt steals Ash's hard-earned Gym badges, Ash chases after it-right into a raging snowstorm!
Max finds an injured Ralts and tries to get it to a Pokémon Center, but its friends Gardevoir and Kirlia think our heroes are trying to steal it!
Ash gets ready for his final Gym battle in the Hoenn region: a Double Battle against Gym Leader Juan, who used to be a Pokémon Coordinator!
Ash and Juan battle it out in the Sootopolis Gym! Can Ash win his eighth Gym badge to qualify for the Hoenn League?
When May discovers that two of her Poké Balls are missing, she naturally assumes it's Team Rocket! But the culprit could be someone else entirely...
When Team Rocket interrupts a practice battle between May and her rival Drew, our heroes and their Pokémon have to sort out a big mix-up!
Our heroes are delayed by a herd of Donphan on their way to Pacifidlog Town! Can May make it onto the ferry in time for her final Pokémon Contest?
May enters the Pacifidlog Contest, where she goes up against rivals Joshua and Erica, plus a mysterious competitor known only as "The Jester"...
May competes against an unusual Meowth in the second round of the Pacifidlog Contest. Can she win the last ribbon she needs to qualify for the Grand Festival?
When our heroes stumble upon a wonderful berry harvest, May takes the opportunity to make some Pokéblocks for the Grand Festival, drawing the attention of a hungry Munchlax!
Ash meets Morrison, another Trainer who's on his way to compete in the Hoenn League, and the two immediately become fierce rivals!
Aboard a luxury liner bound for Slateport City and the Grand Festival, our heroes must help Officer Jenny catch a master thief!

eps.t: Satoshi and Haruka! Heated Battles in Hoenn!!
eps.ov: This is a clipshow Unaired outside of Japan of Satoshi's (Ash's) gym battles and Haruka's (May's) contest battles. The heroes are still on the boat looking towards the Grand Festival. Ash remembers all of his Hoenn Gym Battles with Roxanne, Norman, Brawly, Juan, Tate and Lisa, while May remembers her Contests with Drew, Grace, Kelly, Harley, Erica and Savannah.
On the first day of the Grand Festival, May runs into her deceitful rival Harley once more!
Ash meets a Coordinator whose ribbons have been stolen, and May listens to some bad advice before her first performance in the Grand Festival!
May is up against Harley in the second round of the Grand Festival! Can she triumph over his treacherous tactics?
When our heroes win free tickets to Ever Grande City for the Hoenn League Championships, they're delighted-until it becomes clear this is another of Team Rocket's schemes!

eps.t: Like a Meowth to a Flame
eps.ov: While training for the Hoenn League, Ash meets fellow Trainer Tyson and his Meowth in boots, and they discover that the ceremonial torch has been stolen!
Ash, Morrison, and Tyson register for the Hoenn League, and it appears that Tyson's Meowth has an unfortunate past...
In the qualifying rounds, Ash faces a serious challenge: he has to win three matches in a row, and each match is a Double Battle!
Ash has made it through the qualifying rounds, but now he faces an impressive Trainer named Katie in a full battle, where both of them will use all six of their Pokémon!
Ash has fallen behind in his full battle against Katie! Can he recover and make it to the second round?
Ash faces his friend and rival Morrison in the second round of the Hoenn League!

eps.t: At the End of the Fray (4)
eps.ov: Ash goes up against his rival Tyson in the quarterfinals of the Hoenn League!
The Hoenn League is over, and it's time for Ash to bid farewell to his traveling companions and head home-but he can't resist one more challenge from a Gym Leader along the way!

eps.t: The Right Place and the Right Mime
eps.ov: Max and May come to visit Ash in Pallet Town, along with Misty and Brock, and they all make plans for another journey together-this time, to the Battle Frontier!
Our heroes stop for a picnic at the base of Mt. Moon, where they encounter the rarely seen Cleffa, Clefairy, and Clefable!
On the way to Ash's first match at the Battle Frontier, our heroes see the Legendary Pokémon Articuno flying through a snowstorm!
Ash calls in his old friend Charizard to help in his battle against Frontier Brain Noland and his friend Articuno!
Provoked by Team Rocket, hordes of Rock-type Pokémon attack our heroes on their way to the Battle Arena!
Ash and friends fall into a trap set by a man who wants to catch a Jigglypuff for his daughter's birthday!

On their way to the Battle Arena, Ash and friends stop by a cake shop, but the line for it is long. They see an Arcanine come running by, and May decides to catch it. However, Drew returns and he also wants to capture it.
Ash and friends rescue a sad Psyduck from a group of Fighting types, but they can't figure out how to cheer it up...
Our heroes and Team Rocket check out a new restaurant owned by two sisters who can't stop squabbling!
After a scientific experiment goes awry, Ash and friends try to track down a Caterpie that has grown to enormous proportions!
Our heroes are in Saffron City for May's first Pokémon Contest in the Kanto region-and her shady rival Harley is competing, too!
The Saffron Pokémon Contest is under way! Can May win her first ribbon in the Kanto region?
Ash checks out the Fighting Dojo in Saffron City and ends up getting recruited as a new student!
Ash and friends wander into a ghost town, where they try to help settle a dispute between a group of Ghost-type Pokémon and a group of Psychic-type Pokémon.
When May's Munchlax gets sick, Ash and friends seek the help of a kindly couple who specialize in healing Pokémon...and who just happen to be James's Nanny and Pop-Pop!

eps.t: A Chip Off the Old Brock
eps.ov: After Brock's Mudkip evolves into a Marshtomp and causes some trouble, Ash and friends befriend an elderly medicine-maker and help her assistants fight off Team Rocket's thieving advances.
At the Battle Arena, Ash battles Frontier Brain Greta for his second Frontier Symbol!
May helps the daughter of a family of Pokémon Egg ranchers start her own Pokémon Contest journey, and receives her own Pokémon Egg as a thank-you gift.
May competes against a former rock'n'roll guitarist and band leader in the Silver Town Pokémon Contest for her second Kanto ribbon!
Taking a break from Ash's training regimen to do a little fishing, our heroes help a young woman keep the ownership of her family's lake from a land developer.
At the Battle Dome, Ash challenges Frontier Brain Tucker, a master of both battle tactics and showbiz savvy, for his third Frontier Symbol.
On their way to the Battle Pike, Ash and friends meet a supercharged Elekid who's on a rampage, attacking everything in sight--including Max!
The Mythical Pokémon Celebi has been injured in the forest, and Ash and friends, along with a Pokémon Ranger, nurse Celebi back to health.
On their way to the Battle Pike, our heroes come across a Pokémon ninja school, where they help the students rescue their Pokémon from Team Rocket's clutches.
At an abandoned train station, May meets a woman who lost the love of her life thanks to a sad twist of fate.
At the Battle Pike, Ash must further hone his on-the-spot strategy skills to defeat a soft-spoken, fierce Frontier Brain named Queen Lucy and win his fourth Frontier Symbol.
After arriving on Potpourri Island, our heroes discover the Pokémon Orienteering competition just about to take place and decide to enter, vying for the coveted Pokémon Teamwork medal!
In the Wisteria Town Pokémon Contest, May discovers she is to compete against her old rival Harley.
As our heroes continue toward May's next Pokémon Contest, Ash's Grovyle finds itself nursing a crush on Nurse Joy's Meganium!
After meeting a new Coordinator named Brianna who's a fan of hers and an even bigger fan of Drew's, May discovers she must battle her in order to win her third Pokémon Contest ribbon.
After a frustrated Sceptile runs off into the forest, Ash and Pikachu go after it and run into a swarm of angry Beedrill--and the next Frontier Brain!
It's time for Ash's next Battle Frontier challenge: a battle in the impressive outdoor arena at the Battle Palace, against Frontier Brain Spenser!

eps.t: King and Queen for a Day!
eps.ov: On their way to Ash's next Battle Frontier challenge, our heroes come across a couple of Pokémon TV stars who aren't feeling well, so Brock's Bonsly and James's Mime Jr. act as stand-ins!
After hearing stories about many Trainers and Pokémon being defeated and taunted by a mysterious talking Pokémon known as Red Lightning, our heroes decide to find out what's really going on.
When Brock meets up with a lovely Pokémon breeder who used to be a Coordinator, she talks him into competing against May in the Gardenia Pokémon Contest!
On their way to the Battle Tower for Ash's next challenge, our heroes come across a cute little Smoochum who is fiercely guarded by three Jynx, and Ash has to convince them he's on their side!
On their way to the Battle Tower, our heroes meet an amazing person who seems to be able to communicate with Pokémon by sensing their feelings...and more surprises await!
After losing to Frontier Brain Anabel, Ash buckles down for some unusual special training--and Anabel joins him! Can he defeat her in the rematch?

After witnessing strange behavior from several kinds of Pokémon on their way to Pewter City, our heroes and Pokémon Ranger Solana encounter an electromagnetic disturbance, which leads them to the discovery of a troubled Deoxys!

eps.t: All That Glitters Is Not Golden!
eps.ov: On their way to Ash's final Frontier Battle and Brock's hometown of Pewter City, our heroes discover a wandering golden Sudowoodo and the estranged Trainer who caused its unusual coloring.
May is going after her fifth Contest Ribbon to qualify for the Grand Festival, but when her shady rival Harley teams up with Team Rocket, things don't look good!
After a shaky start in the Mulberry Pokémon Contest, May makes it through to the finals, where she goes up against "Jessebella"--Team Rocket's Jessie in disguise!
After a squabble causes Jessie and James to part ways, they team up with fellow Team Rocket agents Butch and Cassidy for a Poké Ball-swiping scheme!
Upon arriving in Pewter City, our heroes learn that Brock's old Gym is being remodeled by none other than Team Rocket in disguise, and Brock and Ash must battle them to put a stop to it!
In the ancient ruins beneath the Battle Pyramid, Ash is mysteriously possessed by the spirit of an ancient and evil king, who challenges Frontier Brain Brandon to a battle for all of his Pokémon.
On their way to the Grand Festival, our heroes help a berry farmer reclaim his stolen crop.
As the Grand Festival gets under way at the Indigo Plateau, May has her hands full trying to compete with the best Coordinators in the world, including Harley, Drew, and new friend Solidad!
The Grand Festival is going strong as May faces down one impressive competitor after another!
May faces Drew in the quarterfinals of the Grand Festival, and the two seem to be very evenly matched! Can May come out ahead?

On their way to Ash's rematch with Brandon at the Battle Pyramid in Fennel Valley, our heroes come across a village taking part in the annual ritual of choosing a king, and Ash's Aipom becomes a most unwilling candidate!
Our heroes meet an aspiring comedian named Audrey and her showbiz sidekick and Pokémon partner, Chatot.
Our heroes find themselves embroiled in Pokémon politics as two Weavile face off for leadership of a group of Sneasel!
When our heroes arrive at the Battle Pyramid for Ash's battle with Brandon, they discover a Nurse Joy who's a big fan of Ash and May!
After their recent defeats in important matches at the Battle Pyramid and the Grand Festival, Ash and May are feeling a little down, until several old friends come together to support them.
When Nurse Joy becomes too ill to take care of the Pokémon Center, our heroes pitch in, coming to the aid of a Pokésitter and his charges after a bus accident.
Ash prepares for his final rematch with Brandon at the Battle Pyramid by rounding up the Pokémon he's been with the longest, spending his time sharing old memories with them and training intensely.
Ash has lost to Brandon in two previous battles, and now his Charizard has been defeated! Can he battle back to claim the final Frontier Symbol?
Ash has beaten the Battle Frontier, but his competitive spirit won't let him rest for long, and he and May both sign up for an unofficial Pokémon Contest in Terracotta Town!

eps.t: Home Is Where the Start Is! (2)
eps.ov: After one last contest battle between Ash and May, our heroes go their separate ways, and Ash discovers his next adventure!
